offers_products.reason: Sells software and platforms such as MX Merchant, MX POS, eTab and payables automation, plus APIs.

offers_services.reason: Payment processing, merchant services, banking-as-a-service, payroll and benefits are ongoing services for customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are merchants, ISOs, ISVs, fintechs and businesses, not individuals or households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to merchants, retailers, manufacturers, sports venues, ISOs, software vendors and fintechs.

recurring_revenue.reason: Earns ongoing fees on merchant payment processing volume and platform use by merchants that stay.

cyclical_demand.reason: Merchants need payment processing and banking to operate, so they can't easily postpone it, though volumes shift.

big_ticket.reason: Revenue comes from small, frequent per-transaction fees and subscriptions.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for its payments technology, platform and network rather than staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are small and mid-sized merchants and ISO partners, though it also serves some large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and payments platform needs technology and acquisitions, not plants, fleets or property.
